create_huber_regressor: create a HuberRegressor instance with configurable epsilon, alpha, and fit_intercept parameters
fit_huber_regressor: fit a HuberRegressor model on training data X and y with optional sample weights
predict_huber_regressor: predict target values from a fitted HuberRegressor model using new input data
score_huber_regressor: score a fitted HuberRegressor model on test data X and y returning R-squared value
identify_huber_outliers: identify outlier samples from a fitted HuberRegressor using the outliers_ boolean mask attribute
